scope: Hardware and available local order-package readiness. No supplier contact, uploads, checkout changes or order. No hardware design edits.
hardwareVerdict: The cost-reduced inductors and PCIe socket remain reasonable prototype selections under the recorded assumptions. They do not resolve the independent power-control findings. No new source changes closed those findings since the completed review.

blockers.status: resolved by later native UI export
blockers.evidence: The available downloadable package predates the cost revision. Its BOM has 20 changed-part mismatches, five obsolete indicator positions and five missing current passive positions. The paired Gerbers/CPL describe that old snapshot. Only pricing BOMs were refreshed for the latest revision.
blockers.requiredBeforeOrder: Create and verify a matching native Gerber/BOM/CPL release from this exact source, including the new inductor lands, all current passive parts, current socket and omitted status circuit. Verify part matching/polarity/rotation in the assembly preview.

blockers.evidence: The fresh build exactly matches the reviewed design. The conditional VDD load-step envelope retains sub-millivolt margins in the selected case and out-of-range wider cases. Reset and slot-switch source-return models retain identified short-interruption failure cases.
blockers.requiredBeforeOrder: Complete a pre-fabrication review of VDD dynamic response and reset/slot restart; fix applicable findings and verify the chosen operating envelope. Post-assembly measurements remain part of prototype bring-up; no fabricated measurements are implied.

blockers.evidence: Local process record still has vendorAcceptance.received=false. The mixed-pitch bridge uses filled/capped via-in-pad lands and a proposed 0.06 mm local stencil. The saved quote has special stencil disabled; no current accepted stencil/land/mask process is recorded.
blockers.requiredBeforeOrder: Obtain manufacturer acceptance of the actual BGA land/mask/paste, filled/capped vias and stencil plan, and confirm the correct stackup/fill process and inspection in production files.

reusedRegression.reuseBasis: Identical entire Circuit JSON SHA-256; the last complete run remains applicable.

freshGeometryValidation.scope: All project source/netlist/native placement/routing and physical TS/JS audits, without re-running the Python solvers or CLI shorts/style. Prior full audit remains applicable to this exact board.
